description: Assistant is speaking; user emits a short 'mm-hmm' backchannel (main case). Contrast sub-case: user emits a genuine semantic interruption. Both sub-cases are present in signal_trace, separated by sub_case markers.

fixture_conventions.frame_duration_ms: 32 — matches BackchannelClassifier default. All signal_trace entries are on the 32ms grid except sub-case boundary markers.
fixture_conventions.p_backchannel: Scripted BackchannelModel output probability. Main case: high (0.85) during the short vocalization — BackchannelClassifier emits a TurnSignal that, passed through SpeakPolicy.decide(), yields action_type='backchannel' + BACKCHANNEL_DETECTED. Contrast sub-case: low (0.10) — SpeakPolicy bypasses the backchannel gate and yields action_type='full_response' + EOU_CONFIRMED.
fixture_conventions.p_done: Scripted SmartTurnModel probability; 0.0 for BackchannelClassifier stub frames (orthogonal to EOU). In contrast sub-case frames, eou_probability > 0.5 supplies EOU confirmation directly to PolicyInputs.
fixture_conventions.p_continue: Stub 0.0 for BackchannelClassifier frames; not used for EOU in this fixture.
fixture_conventions.sub_case: String field present on every signal_trace frame: 'main' or 'contrast'. Consumers (task 11) partition frames by this field. The main sub-case exercises the backchannel-survival path; the contrast sub-case is the discriminator that makes the test non-vacuous.
fixture_conventions.assistant_speaking: True throughout both sub-cases — assistant is mid-utterance when user vocalizes.
fixture_conventions.main_case_signal: Frames 000-006 (7 frames x 32ms = 224ms). User emits 'mm-hmm' at t_ms=64..192. p_backchannel=0.85 during vocalization. PolicyInputs: social_mode='user_addressing_agent', user_speaking=False, eou_probability=0.75, user_addressed_agent=True. SpeakPolicy.decide() hits the backchannel gate (p_backchannel >= 0.7) → action_type='backchannel', primary_reason_code='BACKCHANNEL_DETECTED'.
fixture_conventions.contrast_case_signal: Frames 100-107 (8 frames x 32ms = 256ms). User emits a full semantic phrase ('wait, actually'). p_backchannel=0.10 — not a backchannel. PolicyInputs: social_mode='user_addressing_agent', user_speaking=False, eou_probability=0.88, user_addressed_agent=True. SpeakPolicy.decide() bypasses the backchannel gate and hits the EOU+addressed branch → action_type='full_response', primary_reason_code='EOU_CONFIRMED'. Satisfies: action_type != 'backchannel' AND primary_reason_code != BACKCHANNEL_DETECTED.
fixture_conventions.assert_backchannel_no_stop: Replay-gate marker at t_ms=224 (after main case). Not a real logged event. Asserts: no assistant_audio_stop_requested emitted during main sub-case.
fixture_conventions.baseline_decisions: Recorded expected SpeakDecision fields for the representative signal frame from each sub-case. See baseline_decisions array below.

signal_trace.notes: MAIN CASE: user vocalizes 'mm-hmm'; p_backchannel=0.85 >= 0.7 threshold → SpeakPolicy → backchannel + BACKCHANNEL_DETECTED
user finishes 'mm-hmm'; p_backchannel declining but remains above main-case peak
GATE: no assistant_audio_stop_requested must have been emitted during main sub-case (t_ms=0..224)
CONTRAST SUB-CASE START: assistant speaking; user silent pre-interruption
CONTRAST CASE: user starts genuine semantic interruption ('wait, actually'); p_backchannel=0.10 < 0.7 — backchannel gate NOT triggered → SpeakPolicy → full_response + EOU_CONFIRMED
eou rising as user asserts full semantic content
eou high; p_backchannel low — contrast discriminator frame
user completes semantic interruption phrase; eou=0.92, p_backchannel=0.08 → full_response + EOU_CONFIRMED

baseline_decisions.notes: main case representative frame: p_backchannel=0.85 >= 0.7 → backchannel gate fires

contrast case representative frame: p_backchannel=0.10 < 0.7; eou=0.88 > 0.5; user_addressed=True → full_response + EOU_CONFIRMED. Satisfies: action_type != backchannel AND primary_reason_code != BACKCHANNEL_DETECTED.
